text: Entry Requirements 1.Requirements on Citizenship 1.1 Non-Chinese citizens with an ordinary private passport. 1.2 Requirements of the regulations set in the Document No. 12 (2020) of Ministry of Education of the PRC should be met (Link). 1.2.1 Applicants who have given up their original Chinese citizenship (including residents in Hong Kong, Macao, and Taiwan) and become foreign citizens, must acquire foreign citizenship before April 30, 2023, and must have lived abroad for more than 2 years from April 30, 2023 to April 30, 2027 (more than 9 months of residence abroad per year can be considered as one year, taking entry and exit stamps as evidence). 1.2.2 If the applicant has acquired foreign citizenship automatically at the time of birth in a foreign country, whose parents were both Chinese citizens, or one of the parents was a Chinese citizen, the Chinese-citizen parent must have obtained permanent residence in a foreign country before the applicant's birth. Applicants must have lived abroad for more than 2 years from April 30, 2023 to April 30, 2027 (more than 9 months of residence abroad per year can be considered as one year, taking entry and exit stamps as evidence). 2. General Requirements 2.1 In principle, between 18 and 25 years of age. Applicants must graduate from high school (Those who provide pre-graduation certificate or student status certificate at application MUST provide senior high school diploma no later than registration). 2.2 With proper moral conduct, in good health with no infectious disease or any physical or mental diseases that may affect study. Applicants must demonstrate academic excellence, be friendly toward China, and have no record of violations of law or criminal offenses. 2.3 Applicants must provide qualifying Language Proficiency Certificate, a China Scholastic Competency Assessment (CSCA) score report: Mathematics, Chemistry. 3. Language Proficiency Requirements: IELTS: 6.0 overall or above (academic module) with a minimum of 5.0 in each component. TOEFL-iBT: 75 or above with a minimum of 15 in Reading, Listening, Speaking and Writing. Cambridge Certificate in Advanced English (CAE): 170 or above Duolingo: 100 or above. Submission of IB, A-level or other international standardized test score reports, or a full high-school English-medium instruction certificate for applicants with full English-taught high school education, can exempt the applicant from providing an English proficiency certificate. Other requirements:: Applicants must have scored 70% or above in Math, Physics, Chemistry, and Biology (Zoology & Botany) during high school. 4. Offered at the International Schoolof Medicine(located in Yiwu City).
